# Art of Bicycle Trips

> > Expert-led bicycle and e-bike tours across India, Asia, Europe, and the Balkans, offering personalized active travel experiences with local cultural immersion.

Art of Bicycle Trips, founded by Pankaj Mangal, specializes in guided cycling adventures across diverse destinations including India (Rajasthan, Kerala, Tamil Nadu), Albania, Austria, Bali, Balkans, Belgium, and Bhutan. The company provides premium bike rentals (Scott, Trek, Giant, Fuji, Marin) and all-inclusive packages emphasizing local experiences, joie de vivre, and ikigai philosophy.

## Key Topics

- Guided cycling tours
- E-bike tours
- India bicycle tours (Rajasthan, Kerala, Tamil Nadu)
- European cycling (Albania, Austria, Balkans, Belgium)
- Asian tours (Bali, Bhutan)
- Premium bike rentals (Scott, Trek, Giant, Fuji, Marin)
- Local cultural experiences
- All-inclusive packages
- Personalized adventures
- Active travel
- Accommodation options
- Expert local guides
- Joie de vivre travel philosophy
- Small group tours
- Custom itineraries
